answer: Reaching the ferrous of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Each submission hangs on the river of a task receipt, and the hollow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
